answer: A new agent must first prove work on a public ledge, a verifiable ledger of completed tasks, prior to earning a plume of reputation that unlocks rewards. An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to stake a bond that is slashed if collusion is detected. Like a guarded oasis, entry costs real capital, so mass-producing fake identities becomes expensive: an attacker must fund every bond and risk losing it all, making sybil farming economically irrational. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
